notes.title: Codename: Terranova 2.0
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the new version of [b]Codename: Terranova[/b].

What’s new:
[list]
[*] 60+ base modules 
[*] 10+ boss modules  
[*] 11 missions
[*] 10+ puzzles
[*] 50+ challenges
[*] 3 new game modes: custom play, campaign and quick play
[*] O.C.S.: More interaction and a completely new UI
[/list]
[b]…Everything randomly generated![/b]

Speed and precision are required to set a new record. 
Will you have the necessary concentration?

[previewyoutube=kshaEMLorgE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: First steps towards procedural game
notes.notes:
The staircases. They like to change ... Or maybe it was the windows?! First steps towards procedural game.
We keep our promises and are working on a pretty big overhaul to the game. Procedurally generated trains are coming and this is only a small part of what we have in mind. We hope to give you more news soon. Stay tuned 

[previewyoutube=GDAtwCurb1I;full][/previewyoutube]
